task.name: Task 2: Advertise the existing resume capability and turn the contracts green (GREEN)
task.behavior: - `initializeResponse` unconditionally sets both `Options` and `Resume` to non-nil empty SDK capability structs. - The exact adapter and composed initialize frames contain only options and resume within sessionCapabilities. - Orca's capability gate now reaches `ResumeSession`; the backend sees resume then subscribe for the same id and no replacement/create, model rebind, or history replay. - Existing resume delegation, validation, cwd/settings recording, closing-race, and no-replay lifecycle tests remain unchanged and green.
task.action:
Per D-01/D-03/D-04, make the single production change in `initializeResponse`: set `SessionCapabilities.Resume = &acp.SessionResumeCapabilities{}` beside the existing `Options` assignment. Keep it unconditional, with no dependency on auth state, client identity, session existence, or backend response; `ResumeSession` is already implemented and the front owns per-session validation and lifecycle behavior.
Update the nearby adapter and initialize comments to state that resume is advertised because the SESS-01 lifecycle delegates to the front, while close/delete remain deliberately unadvertised and load/list/fork remain unsupported. Do not change `ResumeSession`, `Handlers`, `Front.ResumeSession`, backend method constants, SDK imports, or any capability field other than resume. Do not add load support, history replay, model switching, or new production symbols.
Run the focused contracts, both affected package race suites, and package lint. This is GREEN for Task 1's RED evidence; no additional behavior or fallback path is authorized.

task.done: Initialize advertises exactly options and resume as empty objects; the Orca-gated wire test reaches backend resume then subscribe with the same session id and no replacement, model switch, or replay; all affected package race tests and lint pass.
task.acceptance_criteria: - `SessionCapabilities.Resume` is non-nil and marshals as `{}` on every initialize response. - `LoadSession` remains false and list/fork/delete/close capability pointers remain nil. - The new gate test proves initialize -> client capability decision -> session/resume -> backend resume -> backend subscribe for one unchanged id. - The gated backend transcript has exactly two inbound requests and zero create/setModel/send/messages frames; the client collects zero replay updates. - Existing resume lifecycle tests and both affected package race suites pass. - Strict lint reports zero affected-package issues.
task.artifacts: - Modified `initializeResponse` in `internal/acpport/agent.go`; no new production symbol. - GREEN verification results for the adapter, composed-wire, conformance, and resume lifecycle contracts.
